📝 Walkthrough ## Walkthrough The PR adds the James Tower Godot project, implements tower-defense gameplay and rendering, documents the project, and adds a GitHub Pages web deployment workflow. ### Changes **Game and delivery** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Project foundation and game scene**
`project.godot`, `scenes/main.tscn`, `assets/icon.svg.import`, `scripts/main.gd.uid`, `DESIGN.md`, `README.md`, `docs/mobile-notes.md`|Defines the portrait Godot project, main HUD scene, asset import settings, controls, game rules, local run steps, and mobile setup notes.| |**Gameplay state and combat**
`scripts/main.gd`|Implements mana, summoning, tower merging, enemy spawning and movement, tower attacks, status effects, game-over handling, restart handling, and `get_game_state()`.| |**HUD and game rendering**
`scenes/main.tscn`, `scripts/main.gd`|Connects HUD controls and renders the board, path, crystal, towers, enemies, health bars, status effects, and attack effects.| |**Web export and project support**
`export_presets.cfg`, `.github/workflows/pages.yml`, `.gitignore`|Configures the Web export, builds it with Godot 4.7.2, deploys the build to GitHub Pages, and ignores generated files and platform outputs.| **Estimated code review effort:** 4 (Complex) | ~45 minutes ### Sequence Diagram(s) ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant Player participant MainScript participant HUD participant Enemies Player->>MainScript: Summon or merge towers MainScript->>HUD: Update status and controls MainScript->>Enemies: Spawn and advance enemies Enemies->>MainScript: Reach the crystal or receive damage MainScript->>HUD: Update mana, crystal health, kills, and game-over state ```
✨ Finishing Touches
